card.name: Fetal renal function warning sentence
card.fires_on: The word "function" after "renal" or "kidney", mostly in the standard warning that renin-angiotensin drugs reduce fetal renal function. It also fires on "kidney" in "impaired kidney function" and, rarely, on a stray digit.
